decisions.reason: The requirement already mandates matching the reference's beige finish exactly; the rendered-colors clause does not establish a different finish or add a new constraint.
The branding details in the source do not change the support base's height, cup clearance, structure, or footprint alignment.

The broad visual-identity requirement already specifies reproduction of the reference renderings; message 201 supplies details owned by narrower branding, control-styling, color, and lighting requirements without changing the broader visual goal.
A same-message MODIFY already records the rendered button design, Deck 1 and Deck 2 labels, and rendered back-panel design and font; the bottom logo belongs to the source branding requirement.
The candidate already requires the color scheme shown in the renderings, so the instruction to reproduce the rendered colors reiterates rather than changes its current state.
A same-message MODIFY already records the requirement for lighting around the power button.
The source specifies graphics and visual details but does not change enclosure size, thickness, or accepted physical proportions.
The source does not discuss or alter the spout's appearance, material, or fabrication method.
The logo along the bottom is a distinct branding element and does not change the Elena's Chai Whisk placard text, placement, orientation, or display sides.
The visual branding instruction has no effect on food-contact material requirements.
The source does not change cleaning access, sanitation, or liquid-path design constraints.
Lighting around the power button is a decorative-lighting constraint and does not change the required power-control method.
